checksum_from_checksum_roundtrip.statement: ∀ (sum : U32), ∃ (s : Adler32) (out : U32), Adler32.from_checksum sum = .ok s ∧ Adler32.checksum s = .ok out ∧ out = sum

from_checksum_checksum_roundtrip.statement: ∀ (s : Adler32), ∃ (sum : U32) (restored : Adler32), Adler32.checksum s = .ok sum ∧ Adler32.from_checksum sum = .ok restored ∧ restored = s

split_update.statement: ∀ (s : Adler32) (x y xy : Slice U8), x.val.length + y.val.length ≤ Usize.max → xy.val = x.val ++ y.val → ∃ (sx sxy whole : Adler32), Adler32.write_slice s x = .ok sx ∧ Adler32.write_slice sx y = .ok sxy ∧ Adler32.write_slice s xy = .ok whole ∧ sxy = whole

save_restore_resume.statement: ∀ (s : Adler32) (x y xy : Slice U8), x.val.length + y.val.length ≤ Usize.max → xy.val = x.val ++ y.val → ∃ (sx : Adler32) (saved : U32) (restored resumed whole : Adler32), Adler32.write_slice s x = .ok sx ∧ Adler32.checksum sx = .ok saved ∧ Adler32.from_checksum saved = .ok restored ∧ Adler32.write_slice restored y = .ok resumed ∧ Adler32.write_slice s xy = .ok whole ∧ resumed = whole

notes: Independent exact theorem assignments on freshly rebuilt modules; no new proof authoring.
Split/update and save/restore/resume require representable concatenation and an explicitly matching concatenated slice.
